title: Walk in Love and Remain in Christ's Teaching
summary_text: The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children, rejoicing that some of them are living by the truth. He urges them to keep the commandment they have known from the beginning: to love one another by obeying God. Deceivers deny that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh, and those who leave Christ's teaching do not have God. The elder warns against welcoming or greeting such teachers, since doing so shares in their evil deeds. He hopes to visit and speak face to face so their joy can be complete.
key_points: The elder loves the lady and her children in truth and rejoices that some follow the Father's command.
Love means living by God's commandments, including the command to love one another.
Deceivers refuse to confess Jesus Christ coming in the flesh, while remaining in His teaching means having the Father and Son.
Welcoming teachers who reject Christ's teaching shares in their evil deeds.
The elder hopes for a joyful visit and passes on greetings from the children of the lady's elect sister.
